verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents "network interception" as part of full browser control, which in principle lets a developer block image and CSS requests themselves. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in, default-on setting for blocking these resources or any stated bandwidth or speed benefit. missing for 10: a documented default resource-blocking option (images/CSS), configuration docs or examples for blocking resource types, evidence of bandwidth or speed impact, independent or hands-on corroboration.
